<div>

<p id="xdx_984_edei--AmendmentDescription_c20260331__20260331_zOo4K3sDGqDe" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31" id="Fact000027" name="dei:AmendmentDescription">KiNRG,
Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is filing this Amendment No. 2 on Form 8-K/A (this &#8220;Amendment No. 2&#8221;) to amend its Current
Report on Form 8-K/A filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on May 21, 2026 (the &#8220;Amendment No. 1&#8221;), which amended
the Company&#8217;s Current Report on Form 8-K filed on April 2, 2026 (the &#8220;Original Report&#8221;).<br/>
<br/>
The sole purpose of this Amendment
No. 2 is to replace Exhibit 99.1 and Exhibit 99.2 previously filed with Amendment No. 1 with the correct Exhibit 99.1 and Exhibit 99.2.
Except as set forth herein, this Amendment No. 2 does not amend, modify or update any other disclosure contained in the Original Report
or Amendment No. 1.</ix:nonNumeric></p>
